newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore electronics output up 9 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Singapore electronics output up 9 percent in 1996.

text.p: Singapore's electronics sector grew nine percent in 1996 to a total output of Singapore $63.1 billion, said the Economic Development Board on Monday.
The board said in a statement the industry's fixed assets commitments for 1996 were about S$3.4 billion, up 33 percent over the previous year.
EDB sees the electronics sector achieving higher growth in line with global expectations in 1997.
However, the consumer electronics sector saw its output decline 20 percent to S$5 billion in 1996.
The board said gross value added for the industry increased 12 percent to S$17.0 billion.
Projects committed this year will generate an estimated incremental gross value added of more than S$2.9 billion.
The data storage and office automation sectors posted record output of S$18.3 billion and S$5.3 billion in 1996, up 29 percent and 40 percent respectively, it added.
